title: Chinese Stew with Peas
description: A hearty Chinese-inspired stew made with tender beef and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Irish stew, peas, and zesty, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
